subject: english
question:
**Direction: Find the part of the given sentence that has an error in it. If there is no error, choose 'No error'.**

Tax dispute settlement might not work out in the desired scale.
solution:
Here, the erroneous part is **"might not work out in."**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__** 

__
 
• The error lies in the part "might not work out in."
 
• The reason to use** "at"** in the blank is that it is the correct preposition to indicate the level or extent to which the tax dispute settlement may or may not be successful.
 
• **"At the desired scale"** suggests the specific point or degree at which the settlement is expected to be effective or comprehensive.
 
• The preposition **"at"** is commonly used in this context to convey a particular level or scale.
 
• The correct answer is Option 1.

Correct sentence: *Tax dispute settlement might not work out **at**__ the desired scale.*
